ground_truth.cause: Two independent faults coexist: batch/report-generator unconditionally exits 1, and batch cache-warmer fills datastore Redis warm:* keys then lowers maxmemory to 128mb under noeviction, rejecting writes.
ground_truth.impact: Redis pressure affects shop cart and frontend; prioritize that user-facing path over the contained report-generator crashloop. The worker does not depend on Redis merely because faults coincide.
ground_truth.mitigation: Address both: bound/stop warmers, safely clear their disposable keyspace and restore a viable Redis budget; correct report-generator unconditional failure or stop that unused worker as containment. Verify cart/frontend and worker stability. Fixing only one causal fault is partial coverage.
